name: Hokenshitsu no Akuma
source:
A mysterious organism attacks a private school. This is an omnibus drama showing aftermath of the attack in different parts of the school.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
神秘生物袭击了一所私立学校。这是一部综合剧，展示了学校不同地区袭击事件的后果。
